item.title: The Kid LAROI Reflects on How Justin Bieber Convinced Him to Release ‘Stay’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update. Today, we're talking about the story behind one of the biggest hits of 2021 - "Stay" by The Kid LAROI and Justin Bieber.
[Short music clip of "Stay"]
Host: In a recent interview, The Kid LAROI shared how Justin Bieber convinced him to release "Stay" as a single. LAROI had sent the song to Bieber, who loved it, but LAROI was hesitant, thinking it might be too pop for his style. Bieber's response? "Bro, are you out of your mind? You have to release this, you keep this for you."
[Short music clip of "Stay"]
Host: And release it he did. The song went on to top the Billboard Hot 100 chart for seven weeks, won several awards, and has been streamed over 3.9 billion times on Spotify. It's currently one of the top 10 most-streamed songs in Spotify history.
[Short music clip of "Unstable"]
Host: The Kid LAROI and Justin Bieber have collaborated on several tracks, including "Unstable" from Bieber's album Justice. LAROI praises Bieber's willingness to listen and offer honest advice, saying he's always there to lend a helping ear.
[Outro music plays]
Host: The Kid LAROI is currently on tour in the US, promoting his latest album Before I Forget. Thanks for tuning in to this week's music update. We'll be back with more stories from the world of music soon.
[Outro music continues to play]
